speed.label: Run speed
speed.help: Top speed, in tiles per second. The whole level is measured against this: change it and re-check your gaps.

accel.label: Ground: speed up
accel.help: How fast you reach top speed on the ground. 70 = full speed in about a tenth of a second. Low = heavy, slow to get going.

decel.label: Ground: stop
decel.help: How fast you stop when you let go. Low = slides like ice.

turn.label: Ground: turn round
turn.help: How fast you reverse direction. Higher than 'stop' makes turning feel snappy instead of mushy.

airAccel.label: Air: speed up
airAccel.help: Steering strength in the air. 0 = you can't steer a jump at all.

airDecel.label: Air: stop
airDecel.help: How fast you lose sideways speed in the air when you let go. Low keeps the momentum of a running jump.

airTurn.label: Air: turn round
airTurn.help: How fast you can reverse in the air. High = you can save a bad jump.

height.label: Jump height (tiles)
height.help: How high a full, held jump goes. Levels are built for about 3: a 3-tile step is the tallest climb.

gravity.label: Gravity (rising)
gravity.help: Pull while going up. Higher = a quicker, snappier jump of the same height. Lower = floaty.

fallGravity.label: Fall gravity x
fallGravity.help: Extra pull on the way down. Above 1 makes the fall faster than the rise, which feels weighty.

maxFall.label: Top fall speed
maxFall.help: You never fall faster than this (tiles per second), so long drops stay steerable.

cut.label: Short-hop cut
cut.help: Let go of jump early and you keep this share of your upward speed: tap = hop, hold = full jump. 1 = every jump is full height.

coyote.label: Coyote time (s)
coyote.help: You can still jump this long after running off a ledge. Without it, jumps at the very edge feel 'eaten'.

buffer.label: Jump buffer (s)
buffer.help: A jump pressed this long before landing still happens on landing.

apexSpeed.label: Apex hang: zone
apexSpeed.help: Near the top of a jump (slower than this, up or down) gravity gets lighter while jump is held. 0 = no hang.

apexGravity.label: Apex hang: gravity x
apexGravity.help: How light gravity gets at the top. 0.5 = half. It buys a beat to aim the landing. 1 = off.

cornerNudge.label: Ceiling corner nudge
cornerNudge.help: If your head clips the corner of a block by less than this (in tiles), you slide round it instead of stopping dead. 0 = off.

ledgeLift.label: Ledge lift
ledgeLift.help: If your feet land less than this (in tiles) below the top of a ledge, you are lifted onto it. 0 = off.

enabled.label: Wall slide + wall jump
enabled.help: Push against a wall while falling to slide slowly; press jump to kick off it. Turn off for a simpler, classic game.

slideSpeed.label: Slide speed
slideSpeed.help: How fast you slip down a wall you are pushing against (tiles per second).

jumpUp.label: Wall jump: up
jumpUp.help: Share of a normal jump's upward speed.

jumpAway.label: Wall jump: away
jumpAway.help: Sideways kick off the wall, tiles per second.

lock.label: Wall jump: steering lock (s)
lock.help: For this long after a wall jump, steering is ignored so the kick carries you away. Short enough and you can climb a single wall.

grace.label: Wall jump: grace (s)
grace.help: You can still wall jump this long after leaving the wall (coyote time for walls).

speed.label: Platform speed
speed.help: Average speed of moving platforms, tiles per second.

wait.label: Platform wait (s)
wait.help: How long a platform rests at each end of its track: the moment to step on or off.

speed.label: Crawler speed
speed.help: Tiles per second. Slow enough to read and jump on.

turnPause.label: Pause before turning (s)
turnPause.help: A crawler stops for a beat at a wall or ledge before walking back: its tell.

stompGrace.label: Stomp: extra width
stompGrace.help: The stomp counts this far (in tiles) either side of the enemy. Generous on purpose.

stompBounce.label: Stomp bounce
stompBounce.help: Upward speed after squashing an enemy.

stompBounceHeld.label: Stomp bounce (jump held)
stompBounceHeld.help: Hold jump while you stomp to bounce higher.

hurtShrink.label: Hurt box shrink
hurtShrink.help: The part of an enemy that hurts is this much smaller (tiles, each side) than it looks. Near misses are forgiven.

viewHeight.label: View height (tiles)
viewHeight.help: How many tiles fit top to bottom. Smaller = closer, bigger character.

lookAhead.label: Look ahead (tiles)
lookAhead.help: The camera shifts this far in the direction you face, so you see what is coming.

lookAheadSpeed.label: Look-ahead speed
lookAheadSpeed.help: How quickly the camera swings round when you turn. Low = calm; a quick change of direction doesn't whip the view.

followX.label: Follow speed (sideways)
followX.help: Higher = the camera sticks closer to the player.

deadZoneUp.label: Dead zone: up (tiles)
deadZoneUp.help: The camera ignores jumps lower than this, so hopping doesn't bob the whole screen. Keep it just above the jump height.

deadZoneDown.label: Dead zone: down (tiles)
deadZoneDown.help: Fall further than this and the camera follows at once, so you see where you land.

followY.label: Catch-up speed (up/down)
followY.help: How quickly the camera moves to your new height after you land somewhere higher or lower.

height.label: Framing height (tiles)
height.help: How far above the player's feet the middle of the screen sits. Higher shows more sky, lower shows more ground.

squash.label: Squash and stretch
squash.help: How rubbery the character is when it jumps and lands. 0 = stiff.

dust.label: Dust puffs
dust.help: Little puffs on take-off, landing, turning and wall slides.

stompStopMs.label: Stomp freeze (ms)
stompStopMs.help: The world freezes this long when you squash an enemy. It makes the hit feel solid.

hurtStopMs.label: Hurt freeze (ms)
hurtStopMs.help: The world freezes this long when you are hurt, so you see what got you.

hurtShake.label: Hurt shake
hurtShake.help: Camera shake when hurt, in tiles.

footsteps.label: Footstep ticks
footsteps.help: A very quiet tick with every stride.

hearts.label: Hearts
hearts.help: Hits you can take in one run.

checkpointHeals.label: Checkpoints give a heart back
checkpointHeals.help: Touching a new checkpoint restores one lost heart.

respawnTime.label: Back in play after (s)
respawnTime.help: How long between being hurt and standing at the checkpoint again. Keep it short: waiting is the real punishment.

invulnTime.label: Safe time after return (s)
invulnTime.help: You blink and can't be hurt for this long after coming back.

coinReach.label: Coin reach (tiles)
coinReach.help: A coin is taken when it is this close to your body. Generous feels better than exact.

spikeShrink.label: Spike forgiveness
spikeShrink.help: Only the inner part of a spike tile hurts; this much (tiles) at each side is safe.

invincible.label: Invincible
invincible.help: Nothing costs a heart (falls still send you back to the checkpoint).
